characterConstruction.strokeWeight: medium-heavy opaque flat strokes; relatively even body with local directional cuts
characterConstruction.proportion: visibly taller and narrower than square Chinese sans; maintain readable internal counters
characterConstruction.terminals: several decisive flat or oblique cuts and sharp folded joins, never rounded bubble ends

characterConstruction.edge: clean hard edge; no uniform distress, paper grain, brush bristles or glow
